ground_truth.title: [M-19] `V3Oracle` susceptible to price manipulation
ground_truth.description: V3Oracle.getValue() computes position token amounts from the current Uniswap V3 slot0() price and values them using oracle-derived token prices. _checkPoolPrice() bounds the current pool price against the oracle-implied pool price through maxPoolPriceDifference, but an overly permissive setting can still materially distort the valuation of tight-range positions.
ground_truth.impact: With a tight-range position and a fringe or incorrect maxPoolPriceDifference configuration, an attacker can cause non-dust collateral misvaluation and borrow against an overstated position value. The check limits the effect for wide-range positions and properly constrained configurations; repay() is unaffected because it does not use the oracle.
ground_truth.mitigation: Calculate amount0 and amount1 from the oracle-derived price rather than the current pool spot price returned by slot0().
